aws_region.description: AWS region for the runner instances, for example us-east-1. The region must contain the Canonical Ubuntu AMI publications and the target subnet.

aws_access_key_id.description: IAM access key ID used only for the Terraform AWS provider. Needs ec2:RunInstances/Describe/Terminate plus EBS volume and AMI describe permissions; stored as a sensitive publisher binding and never delivered to the instance.

aws_secret_access_key.description: IAM secret access key paired with aws_access_key_id. Stored as a sensitive publisher binding; it never enters user-data, tags, or guest files.

aws_ami_name.description: Canonical official Ubuntu AMI name pattern resolved with most_recent under owner 099720109477, default ubuntu/images/hvm-ssd/ubuntu-jammy-22.04-amd64-server-*. Pin a dated serial suffix for an immutable image.

aws_instance_type.description: EC2 instance type, default t3.large. Must be available in the bound region and subnet's availability zone.

aws_subnet_id.description: Optional target subnet; empty uses the region's default VPC default subnet. The subnet needs outbound reachability to GitHub and the runner download endpoints.

aws_security_group_ids.description: Optional additional security group IDs; empty attaches the VPC default security group. The template creates no security group itself.

aws_root_volume_gb.description: Encrypted gp3 root volume size in GiB, default 30. The volume is deleted on instance termination.

aws_cloud_init_cmd.description: Optional publisher-authored Bash preparation body, executed as root before the runner install and the mandatory JIT handoff. Default empty. Use code only, never credentials; no variable substitution or JIT environment is provided. Failure prevents runner startup.
